title: Representative Fees in the Veterans Pension Retroactive Release Offset
content:
**Veterans Pension — retroactive Disability Compensation release considered against a pension retroactive release.**

A retroactive Disability Compensation release issued since the pension effective date is considered at the release less the representative's fee taken out of it. The fee taken out turns on the direct-pay fee agreement recorded on the veteran's Disability Compensation award and on the fee withheld shown on those releases in the compensation payment ledger:

- when a direct-pay fee agreement is on file and the fee withheld is no more than 20 percent of the release (the fee cap share), the whole fee is taken out;
- when an agreement is on file and the fee withheld exceeds that share, only 20 percent of the release, rounded to the cent, is taken out;
- with no agreement on file nothing is taken out.

The release here is the gross total of the retroactive compensation releases issued since the pension effective date; the fee withheld is the total withheld from them.

## Figures on both sides (hypothetical release of 8000.00; 20 percent is 1600.00)

| Agreement on file | Fee withheld | Fee taken out | Amount considered |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 1600.00 | 1600.00 | 6400.00 |
| yes | 2400.00 | 1600.00 | 6400.00 |
| yes | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 7000.00 |
| no | 1000.00 | 0 | 8000.00 |
